profile.headline: Frontend Developer at cove
profile.summary: A frontend engineer with a keen eye for detail and a passion for creating pixel-perfect frontend UI,  thinking critically, analytically and logically. I help solve complex problems to create value and make a difference in the world.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Claude Code · Cursor AI · TypeScript · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Software Design · Software Infrastructure · React.js

positions.title: Lead Frontend Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Django · React.js

positions.title: Frontend Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · TypeScript · HTML · JavaScript

positions.title: Lead Frontend Software Engineer
positions.description:
Expert User Interface- Leveraged  ReactJS and Next.js to build highly functional User Interfaces that seamlessly consume RESTful APIs and GraphQl APIs, delivering a seamless user experience.

Cross-Browser Compatibility: Thoroughly tested front-end code across multiple browsers to ensure optimal performance and compatibility for all users.

Re-engineered Front-end Experience: Pioneered the redesign and engineering of a new front-end experience for a e-commerce platform, managing over 5,000 of users, utilizing cutting-edge technologies such as Next.js, and RESTful APIs, powered by a robust NoSQL database.

Guided Web Applications Team: Provided mentorship and technical guidance to Junior engineers, conducting code reviews, sharing best practices, and advocating for reusable and maintainable code to enhance the overall quality of the project.
positions.insights: Skills: Tailwind CSS · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · REST APIs · React.js · Next.js · SASS · JavaScript · HTML5

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Built winning web application at the 2020 Essteem Hackathon using ReactJS.

- Developed and styled the connect page which allows users to connect with civic organizations in their area.

- Restyled the home page to enhance the User Experience using CSS

positions.title: Sports marketing and Business Development Manager
positions.description:
-  Prepare online and print marketing campaigns.

- Write entertaining and effective email marketing materials, press releases, and newsletter articles.

-  Oversee and create the social media strategy ensuring it aligns with the Sports Commission brand.

- Design all graphics including  sales and marketing materials such as catalogues, online banners and branded materials.

positions.title: Software Engineering Instructional Associate
positions.description:
Instructor Associate for the Software Engineering Immersive (SEI) Remote Courses.

Deliver technology skills training for the Software Engineering Immersive (Flex) course, to prepare students for entry-level to mid-level careers in the field of Web Development.

Mentoring and instructing students in JavaScript | React | HTML | CSS | SQL | PHP | Ruby | Ruby on Rails | RESTful API's and Routes | jQuery | AJAX | NodeJS | Express | MongoDB | Mongoose | Bootstrap | Materialize | SASS | Git | Github | Agile/Scrum methodologies.

Also, I provide students with regular, timely feedback on performance, assignments, and course progress.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Refactor code to get the note title to match with the corresponding note source icon and improved the structure and implementation of the bundleIQ desktop widget.

Execute software tests to uncover, identify and document software problems and their causes

positions.title: Software Engineering Fellow
positions.description: A immersive 6 month full stack software engineering program conducted in a remote environment. With over 450 hours of coding that include getting hands-on with leading front-end web development and back-end web development languages: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, Django, Ruby on Rails, React, Angular, or SQL.

positions.title: Street Team Marketing Supervisor
positions.description:
- Serve as a brand ambassador for the Tampa Buccaneers at all grassroots marketing and community events
- Encourage deeper relationships with the team and Buccaneers fans of all ages through interactive programs and initiatives
- Assist as a knowledgeable source of club news and events in the community
- Supervise over 25 part-time staff members in the set-up, breakdown, and execution of community events
- Led gameday activations for over 2,500 fans

positions.title: Marketing Coordinator
positions.description:
- Executed the go-to market strategy for new programs across the brands to include nurture paths for those leads and current leads to convert to new programs being offered.

- Managed the content repository (chat/email templates/knowledge center/communities)

- Audited, organized and maintained brand assets via a creative campaign spreadsheet to help the team identify gaps and opportunities for creative refreshes.

positions.title: Sports Marketing Intern
positions.description: I assisted with coordinating marketing and promotions for all varsity sports and areas of athletics.

positions.title: Graphic Design Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Reviewed course assignment and provided feedback to approximately 20 students. I also assisted students with creating logo's booklets and business stationaries.

positions.title: Account Manager (Intern)
positions.description:
I created quarterly reports for outreach impressions, circulation, Ad and PR Values.

Worked with senior leadership to develop strategic marketing plans.

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description: I coded research data into categories for reports and edited annual visitor tracking reports

positions.title: Customer Service Representative
positions.description: Provided exceptional customer service to over 100 people a day. I helped customers  register their vehicles, renew  and replace their licenses, collect property taxes and administer driving test. I was also trained to identify fake documents  to prevent illegal immigrants from obtaining a Florida license.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Designed CD case and cover for the Ohio state AfricanAmerican Voices Gospel Choir. I also designed Business advertisements for publishing and Created Inspire Magazine model search ad, as well as prototype design of Inspire Magazine cover

positions.title: Coach
positions.description:
I improved students gross motor skills also help students achieve greater flexibility. I helped Develop students posture, balance and coordination. As well as teach students healthy lifestyle habits.Lastly Educate students about the importance of nutrition.
•	Reduces students obesity and maintains fat/lean muscle ratio
